title: 被列覆盖的最多行数
summary: 从二进制矩阵恰选 numSelect 列，一行所有一所在列都被选中时视为覆盖，求最多覆盖行数。
insight: 列数很小，把每行的一位置编码为位掩码，枚举所有恰有 numSelect 位的列掩码；rowMask 是选择掩码子集时该行被覆盖。
pitfalls: 必须恰好选择指定列数

solutions.title: 枚举选列掩码
solutions.idea: 位运算快速检查每行覆盖关系。

code.java: class Solution { public int maximumRows(int[][] matrix,int numSelect){int rows=matrix.length,columns=matrix[0].length;int[] masks=new int[rows];for(int r=0;r<rows;r++)for(int c=0;c<columns;c++)if(matrix[r][c]==1)masks[r]|=1<<c;int answer=0;for(int selected=0;selected<(1<<columns);selected++)if(Integer.bitCount(selected)==numSelect){int covered=0;for(int mask:masks)if((mask&selected)==mask)covered++;answer=Math.max(answer,covered);}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun maximumRows(matrix:Array<IntArray>,numSelect:Int):Int{val columns=matrix[0].size;val masks=IntArray(matrix.size);for(r in matrix.indices)for(c in 0 until columns)if(matrix[r][c]==1)masks[r]=masks[r] or (1 shl c);var answer=0;for(selected in 0 until (1 shl columns))if(Integer.bitCount(selected)==numSelect){var covered=0;for(mask in masks)if(mask and selected==mask)covered++;answer=maxOf(answer,covered)};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int maximumRows(vector<vector<int>>& matrix,int numSelect){int columns=matrix[0].size();vector<int> masks(matrix.size());for(int r=0;r<(int)matrix.size();++r)for(int c=0;c<columns;++c)if(matrix[r][c])masks[r]|=1<<c;int answer=0;for(int selected=0;selected<(1<<columns);++selected)if(__builtin_popcount(selected)==numSelect){int covered=0;for(int mask:masks)covered+=(mask&selected)==mask;answer=max(answer,covered);}return answer;} };
